Hi Lena / Tom,

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our discussion, UniComm is open to moving the upcoming renewal from a direct contract to AWS Marketplace billing — great for procurement simplicity on your side and for keeping the subscription in a single place for internal chargebacks.

To keep this moving, I attached a short procurement checklist and a draft amendment that we think will cover the commercial terms and the mechanics of the billing cutover. High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm pricing parity (we’ll keep the annual committed price identical on Marketplace SKUs).
- Confirm procurement contact for PO routing and billing email for invoice delivery.
- Decide on SKU mapping: per-seat SKU vs. metered usage SKU (we can support either).

Proposed timeline:
1) This week — you review the draft amendment + procurement checklist.
2) Next week — exchange final amendment and send to DocuSign.
3) Target cutover aligned with renewal effective date (we can backdate Marketplace billing to the renewal if that helps with internal accounting).

I’ve copied Marissa and Ben for co-sell/marketplace enablement and legal follow-up. Ben, can you confirm if we need any additional entitlements metadata or an AWS co-sell Concurrence form?

Attachments: procurement-checklist.pdf, amendment-draft-v1.docx

Thanks,

Hi Lena / team,

Quick clarifications from the Marketplace and co-sell side:
- Legal / invoice: Marketplace invoices will be generated by AWS and will list Redwood as the seller-of-record (or the legal entity agreed in the listing). We can ensure the invoice includes the same legal name and tax ID; please confirm your required VAT/Tax fields and we’ll validate with the marketplace team.
- Terms: Moving to Marketplace is implemented via a short amendment (attached) that preserves the underlying license term and termination language — we don’t replace your signed SOW; we route billing through the Marketplace.
- SKU mapping / metering: We can publish two SKUs: a flat annual committed SKU (per-seat) and a metered usage SKU. For renewals it’s common to adopt the committed SKU to match your expected spend and simplify forecasting. Marketplace also exposes usage reports; we can push daily metering exports to your S3 bucket or provide reports via the console.
- Co-sell: If UniComm wants AWS co-sell involvement, we’ll request a Concurrence / deal registration. That can unlock joint GTM and potential AWS credits.

I attached a short sample-invoice.csv that mirrors what AWS will emit (sensitive fields redacted). Markus — I added the HubSpot deal link and the DocuSign envelope to the metadata for tracking.

Thanks,
—
Ben Carter
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
